note: UNVERIFIED. Three language-neutral pseudocode tracing items for languages with no local runtime (spec V1-5, V1-7 BLITZ). Nothing here is ever executed: 'answer' and each transform's 'prints' are hand-traced claims, so these items must be stored with verified = false (evidence uses slip .2 and guess +.1, and mutant matching stays off). Pseudocode rules: SET x TO v assigns; PRINT a, b prints the values separated by one space and ends the line; PRINT "text" prints the text without quotes; WHILE c ... END WHILE tests c before every pass; FOR EACH x IN [...] ... END FOR visits the items in order; IF c THEN s runs s only when c is true. Lines inside a block are indented by four spaces. There are no slots or themes: each template is one fixed item.

variables-assignment.name: Assign and reassign names
variables-assignment.useWhen: you store a value and later replace it
variables-assignment.pitfall: A name keeps its value until a later line assigns again
useCases: Keep a running score that changes each round
Remember the previous value before updating a variable
Swap two values using a temporary name
Count the lives left after each hit
Track the current balance after each deposit
Store a starting value to compare with later

while-loop-termination.name: Loop until a condition
while-loop-termination.useWhen: you repeat until something changes, count unknown
while-loop-termination.template:
WHILE <condition>
    <body that moves toward stopping>
END WHILE
while-loop-termination.pitfall: The condition is checked only before each pass
useCases: Halve a number until it drops below one
Keep asking until the answer is valid
Pay off a loan month by month
Count the digits of a number
Double savings until they reach a goal
Serve customers until the queue is empty

loop-accumulator.name: Accumulate in a loop
loop-accumulator.useWhen: you need one result built from every item
loop-accumulator.template:
SET total TO <start>
FOR EACH <x> IN <xs>
    SET total TO total <op> <x>
loop-accumulator.pitfall: Start the best value at the first item, not 0
useCases: Add up the prices in a shopping cart
Count the words longer than five letters
Find the highest temperature of the week
Join names into one comma-separated string
Multiply all the numbers in a list together
Total the minutes of a playlist

templates.code:
SET price TO 14
SET saved TO price
PRINT "before", price, saved
SET price TO price + 22
PRINT "after", price, saved

transforms.belief: Changing price later also changes saved
transforms.refutation: SET saved TO price gave saved the value price had at that moment; a new value for price later does not reach saved.
transforms.rule: Assignment copies the current value; later changes do not follow.

transforms.belief: The first PRINT already shows the updated price
transforms.refutation: Lines run top to bottom: when the first PRINT runs, the line that changes price has not run yet.
transforms.rule: Each PRINT shows the values as they are at that line.

templates.code:
SET fuel TO 11
WHILE fuel > 0
    SET fuel TO fuel - 4
    PRINT fuel
END WHILE
PRINT "end", fuel

transforms.belief: The loop quits as soon as fuel drops to 0 or below
transforms.refutation: The condition is only checked at the top; once a pass starts, every line of it runs, including the PRINT.
transforms.rule: WHILE checks its condition only before each pass.

transforms.belief: After the loop, fuel holds the last value that passed the test
transforms.refutation: The loop ends only after fuel fails the test, so it keeps the value that failed.
transforms.rule: After a WHILE loop, the variable holds the failing value.

templates.code:
SET best TO 0
FOR EACH t IN [-5, -2, -9]
    IF t > best THEN SET best TO t
END FOR
PRINT best

transforms.belief: Starting best at 0 still finds the highest value
transforms.refutation: Every value here is negative, so none of them beats the starting value and best never changes.
transforms.rule: Start the best value at the first item, not 0.
